title: La macchina del tempo — banco di prova immagini
target: Android; 3 illustrazioni 9:16 da approvare prima del render
style_bible: Original storybook illustration, painterly 2D animation with copper, deep blue and soft golden light, precise silhouettes, dramatic Victorian science-fiction atmosphere, refined depth and expressive faces. No reference to copyrighted contemporary adaptations.
character_bible: Same adult Victorian scientist across all scenes: about 35 years old, short wavy dark hair, short dark beard, navy long coat, burgundy vest, ivory shirt; brass time machine with crystal and ivory controls.

scenes.narration_anchor: Nel laboratorio di un inventore londinese c’è una poltrona di metallo, leve d’avorio
scenes.description: In a lamplit late-Victorian London workshop the dark-haired scientist studies an intricate brass time machine with ivory levers and crystal discs. A full-body view with faces and hands visible, not a comic strip.

scenes.narration_anchor: L’uomo tira una leva. E il mondo scompare.
scenes.description: The scientist sits on his brass time machine, pulls a single ivory lever, and stares wide-eyed through a laboratory window where day and night streak in a remarkable time-lapse. Single cohesive view, no double exposure of characters.

scenes.narration_anchor: La Terra è diventata un giardino immenso, pieno di fiori e palazzi consumati dal tempo.
scenes.description: The same scientist steps cautiously onto grassy ground beside his time machine, looking over luminous overgrown gardens and vast decayed marble architecture beneath a clear future sky. A giant white sphinx stands far away; no other people.
